ALGER, 09 juillet 2025 (APS) — Le Fonds: ALGIERS, July 9, 2025 (APS) — The National Retirement Fund (CNR) organized today an information day dedicated to the digitalization of its exchanges with social mutuals. The event, under the theme “Digital transformation and simplification of procedures: a partnership serving retirees and beneficiaries”, brought together representatives of social mutuals.
Le CNR a présenté les mécanismes de coop: The CNR presented the digital cooperation mechanisms and technological solutions developed within the framework of bilateral conventions signed with social mutuals. These tools aim to simplify administrative procedures, strengthen the exchange of information and improve the quality of services provided to retirees and members.
Le Directeur général du CNR a souligné,: The Director General of the CNR underlined, during his intervention, that the relationship between the Fund and mutual societies, initiated in the 1990s, is evolving towards a strategic partnership. “Our objective is to improve public service and support retirees and their dependents, without commercial or profit-making considerations,” he said. He also highlighted the launch of the project to digitize electronic data exchange, a national first.
L’événement a également permis de présen: The event also made it possible to present the first pilot experiment, launched in partnership with the Mutuelle général de la Sûreté nationale, before its gradual extension to all social mutuals.
